text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If one is to be a proper Umamusume of
the Mejiro
family, "One mustn't let
victory go to one's head."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's vital to remain clearheaded and
balanced, lest
one lose one's footing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do you really believe so? Then, would
you please
puff out your chest on my
behalf? ♪
choice_data_list: 今は浮かれてもいいと思う
そのまま踏ん張って行こう……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We did it! Congratulations. How
wonderfully
gratifying!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's focus our energy on
preparing for
our next victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I shall do my very best.
